intent.purpose: Catch up on substantive posts about AI tools without browsing the feed.
intent.success: A two-minute overview of new, substantive items; nothing if nothing qualifies.

interests.focus: Methods and results for evaluating AI agents.
Practical tools and plugins for coding agents, with concrete examples.

procedure.navigation: Open the entry URL and read the 'Latest' list from the top. Use the visible 'More' control for further items.
procedure.account_identity: Establish the signed-in identity from account UI and use a stable account key scoped to this service.
procedure.read_state: Inspect previews unless opening an item is known to preserve its read state. Describe any source-specific acknowledgement effects before use.
procedure.item_identity: Use each post's canonical link as its ID; one post counts as one item. Fingerprint the author name and the visible title plus excerpt.
procedure.pagination: The list is newest first. A 'More' control loads older posts; the list has no end marker.

selection.include: Posts with a concrete method, result or tool that matches a listed interest. Give the reason for inclusion.
selection.uncertain_relevance: Omit weak matches; do not fill the allowance.
selection.evidence: Summarize only inspected content, label truncated previews and distinguish source claims from verified facts.

coverage_threads.on_access_failure: Report the unavailable surface; do not fall back to another browser or access route.

test: Substantive, clearly outside the listed interests, with a concrete reason to deserve attention.
